verses.text: Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:
lines: Blessed be Yahweh, my rock,
who teaches my hands to war,
and my fingers to battle:

verses.text: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
lines: my loving kindness, my fortress,
my high tower, my deliverer,
my shield, and he in whom I take refuge,
who subdues my people under me.

verses.text: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
lines: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him?
Or the son of man, that you think of him?

verses.text: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
lines: Man is like a breath.
His days are like a shadow that passes away.

verses.text: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
lines: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down.
Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

verses.text: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
lines: Throw out lightning, and scatter them.
Send out your arrows, and rout them.

verses.text: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
lines: Stretch out your hand from above,
rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters,
out of the hands of foreigners,

verses.text: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
lines: whose mouths speak deceit,
whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.text: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
lines: I will sing a new song to you, God.
On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

verses.text: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
lines: You are he who gives salvation to kings,
who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

verses.text: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
lines: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners,
whose mouths speak deceit,
whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.text: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
lines: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants,
our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

verses.text: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
lines: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision.
Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

verses.text: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
lines: Our oxen will pull heavy loads.
There is no breaking in, and no going away,
and no outcry in our streets.

verses.text: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
lines: Happy are the people who are in such a situation.
Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
